## Validation

<!-- List the commands or checks that passed. -->

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] User-facing docs, generated artifacts, Action bundles, schemas, or notices are updated when affected.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private board data, or other sensitive material are included.
- [ ] Vulnerability details are reported through `SECURITY.md` and private vulnerability reporting rather than a public issue or pull request.
